commit_scope: Lift anonymous trace reads into a generic native BML query and its matching physical access path; retire the forced raw-reader entry.
evidence_refs: The final native trace after fe09b5faa4f13e7f5d127dc3927fc8181605f73e retained 24.7-26.3 second serving runtimes; a preceding clear pulse snapshot was not accepted as completion. A new 25-second source profile found 101 samples in anonymous meeting trace reads: every page meeting loaded all event nodes, then filtered the current source point in Python on MainThread.

New query selection is authored as the reusable OrderedTraceRead BML template. Source point stays a database-bound value; null/empty retains the global view. Existing trace marker filtering, same-browser history, folding, durations, privacy hashing and response shapes remain. Retired the Python post-read source filter and two incorrect async declarations. Added only transport wiring through the existing Form bridge and SQLAlchemy resource, not a Python query algorithm or alternate implementation.

Extended native ordered-read schema blueprints with expression columns and partial predicates. Online graph_nodes_trace_source_updated_at is valid and ready. PostgreSQL now selects that index for the source-point lookup; no data was removed or shortened.

The retiring source wrapper failed on BML with unbound-name // because it forced the raw --src reader after staging source. Removed that forcing flag, entering fkwu's normal grammar-discovery/JIT door instead. Exact command bash scripts/fkwu_run.sh --src api/app/form_recipes/anonymous_trace_query.bml now exits 0 and emits the bound SQL from BML. No kernel change, separate lowering command or fallback.
Minimal source and native query/access-path observations only; no kernel or application suite. Public serving identity and the affected route/pulse observations follow the superseding rollout.

local_validation.summary: Native query through actual source runner; online index validity/query plan and source profile; no suite.
